name: HYDRA-UMC-JOB-DISPATCHER
notes: Real priority-based job queue with a real HTTP API, tested. Deterministic priority ordering is now covered by an explicit repeated-run regression test. Engine.SubmitJob() adds real, opt-in DedupKey-based deduplication (POST /jobs/submit alongside the unchanged POST /jobs): a repeat submission of an in-flight or already-done job is returned unchanged, and a retry after a real failure reuses the same job ID instead of running the work twice. NewEngineWithStore() (src/sqlitestore) adds real, opt-in (-db PATH) SQLite persistence - the mission queue now survives a real process restart, verified end-to-end with an actual killed-and-relaunched binary, not just unit tests; GET /health reports a degraded store via LastPersistError() instead of failing silently.
